title: Numeric conversion without error checking (c)
description: The code parses a number with atoi, which returns zero on invalid input and has no defined behaviour on overflow. A length, offset or identifier taken from input therefore becomes a value the caller never supplied. This lexical rule flags the conversion; the reviewer checks the range.
remediation: Parse with a function that reports errors and bounds, for example strtol with an end pointer and a range check, and reject out-of-range values.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the conversion without tracing the value into its uses.
